reason: I move shelves based on what I see on my store walks and what has worked for years, and I'm not locking myself into almost a million pesos a year for a computer guess from a company with zero customers. If I want to test a layout, I change it in two stores and watch the sales myself.
objection: A simulation is not real shoppers. Why would I trust made-up customers over my own eyes and my own POS numbers, especially when nobody has used this yet?
would_change_my_mind: A free or very cheap pilot in a few of my own stores where its recommendation actually beats my own layout in real sales, or proof that one of the big chains I watch is using it and getting results.
